caseName: Teachers Insurance & Annuity Ass'n v. Spirt
caseNameFull: Teachers Insurance & Annuity Assn. v. Spirt and Long Island University v. Spirt

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Arizona Governing Committee for Tax Deferred Annuity and Deferred Compensation Plans v. Norris, ante, p. 1073. Reported below: 691 F. 2d 1054.
